Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 1694/2022 Rahul Vaishnav S/o Shri Ramniwas, Aged About 28 Years, Village Jagdishpura, Teh. Parbatsar, Dist. Nagaur (Raj.).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State of Rajasthan through P.P.
 ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Surendra Singh Choudhary.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, P.P.
 Mr. Mohan Singh.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/07/2023

This anticipatory bail application has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C. by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with F.I.R. No.03/2022, registered at Police Station Degana, District Nagaur, for the offences under Sections 420 & 120-B IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner had preferred S.B. Criminal Misc.(Pet.)
No.1144/2022 (Rahul Vaishnav Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr.), before this Court praying for quashing of the F.I.R. No.03/2022, registered at Police Station Degana, District Nagaur, lodged against him.

entities.text:
S.B. Criminal Misc.(Pet.)
No.1144/2022 (Rahul Vaishnav Vs. State of Rajasthan & Anr.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel submitted that learned Public Prosecutor appearing before the coordinate Bench of this Court in S.B. Criminal Misc.(Pet.) No.1144/2022 informed that the investigating agency after thorough investigation into the matter, has (2 of 2) [CRLMB-1694/2022]
found the offences alleged against the co-accused Bhanwar Sa to be proved whereas the petitioner has been exonerated of the charges.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that in view of the fact that the investigating agency did not find the charges proved against the petitioner, the present bail application has become infructuous.
In view of the above submissions, nothing remains to be adjudicated upon in the present anticipatory bail application.
